scripts.dev: npm run build -w @reviesnest/contracts && npm run build -w @reviesnest/google-business && concurrently -n web,api,worker "npm run dev -w @reviesnest/web" "npm run dev -w @reviesnest/api" "npm run dev -w @reviesnest/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @reviesnest/contracts && npm run build -w @reviesnest/google-business && npm run build -w @reviesnest/api && npm run build -w @reviesnest/worker && npm run build -w @reviesnest/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @reviesnest/contracts && npm run build -w @reviesnest/google-business && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @reviesnest/contracts && npm run build -w @reviesnest/google-business && npm run test -w @reviesnest/api
